question: The Board of Control established to control company affairs had how many members?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Six**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Board of Control, established in **1784 under Pitt's India Act**, consisted of **six** **members**.
 
• It was a **British government body** responsible for overseeing the **political and military affairs** of the British East India Company in India. The Board was appointed by the British monarch and was accountable to Parliament.
 
• It was created to increase British government control over the **East India Company's activities in India.**
 
• The Board had the power to approve or disapprove the Company's decisions regarding war, peace, and alliances.
 
• The Board was also responsible for overseeing the Company's financial affairs and ensuring that its revenues were used properly.
 
• The Board of Control was **abolished** in** 1858 **after the **Indian Rebellion of 1857.**
